_note: PSS-10 (Perceived Stress Scale). Options 0–4 (Never=0 to Very Often=4); options are stored as 0-based values. Items 4,5,7,8 (felt_confident_to_handle_problems, felt_things_going_your_way, able_to_control_irritations, felt_on_top_of_things) are positively worded and reverse-scored. Range 0–40.
